newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Arranger group forms for COSCO (HK) Group loan.
newsitem.headline: Arranger group forms for COSCO (HK) Group loan.

text.p: An arranger group has formed for COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd's US$200 million revolving credit/term loan facility, bankers said on Wednesday.
Eight banks have joined HSBC Investment Bank Asia as arrangers for the deal, they said.
They are Banque Nationale de Paris, Banque Paribas, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, Credit Agricole, Development Bank of Singapore, Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp, Sakura Bank and WestLB.
The five-year facility pays a margin of 75 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 30 basis points for co-arrangers committing US$10 million or above and 25 basis points for senior managers committing US$5 million to US$9 million.
COSCO (Hong Kong) Group is a wholly owned unit of China's Ocean Shipping (Group) Co, which is controlled by the Chinese Ministry of Communications.
COSCO (Hong Kong) Group also holds a major share of Hongkong-listed COSCO Pacific Ltd.
